title: Count Per Category
flavorText: GROUP BY splits rows into groups before the aggregate runs. Instead of one total, you get one result per group.
narrative: The Bureau wants a breakdown: how many products exist in each category?
schemaSql: CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, price REAL NOT NULL, stock INTEGER NOT NULL);
seedSql: INSERT INTO products VALUES (1,'Datapad','Electronics',299.99,45),(2,'Power Cell','Electronics',19.99,200),(3,'Steel Cable','Hardware',8.50,500),(4,'Logic Board','Electronics',89.99,30),(5,'Ceramic Fuse','Hardware',2.25,1000),(6,'Optic Lens','Optics',149.99,15),(7,'Servo Motor','Robotics',55.00,80),(8,'Pressure Valve','Hardware',12.75,300);
task: Count the number of products in each category. Order by category name alphabetically.

hints.text: GROUP BY category splits rows into one group per unique category value. Then COUNT(*) runs per group.
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category;
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category;
